entities.summary: Andrés Pablo Forray, also called Toto Forray, is an Argentine-born naturalized Italian professional basketball player for Aquila Basket Trento of the Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He is a 6 ft 2 in (1.88 m) point guard.
